unsupported: The company was founded by Zeb Smith, a native of the region who built carpentry skills working with his father before earning a business degree from BYU.
After three years as lead installer and four years total at Solar Tech VT, plus experience in solar mounting manufacturing, Smith launched his own venture to provide full-service solar solutions.
The firm delivers turnkey photovoltaic systems for homes and businesses, handling design, permitting, installation, and ongoing maintenance.
Projects begin with a detailed site evaluation that measures roof orientation, pitch, and shading, then proceeds to either roof-mounted or ground-mounted arrays with concealed conduit runs.
Customers range from residential owners in towns like Greensboro to commercial operations such as Butternut Mountain Farm, whose president praised the battery backup design.
Most work is concentrated in northern Vermont, though the service area extends across the state.
Smith's hands-on background in mounting hardware informs the company's emphasis on structural integrity and aesthetic conduit routing.

The business differentiates itself by keeping the owner directly involved in every project, from initial consultation to final commissioning, and by offering a single point of contact for both installation and long-term service.
